topic: Most popular websites based on historical Tranco top-sites ranking

interpretations.label: Tranco Composite Rank
interpretations.description: Aggregated ranking combining multiple traffic metrics and top-site lists (such as Chrome UX Report, Cloudflare Radar, Farsight DNSDB) using a robust combination mechanism to resist manipulation.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Integer rank position from 1 to 1000 based on the Tranco list aggregation algorithm (lower number means higher popularity/rank).
caveats: Tranco ranking reflects domain-level presence rather than individual page views.
Composition of underlying data sources evolved over the 2019-2026 period (e.g., deprecation of Alexa/Quantcast, addition of Cloudflare Radar and CrUX).

knownRisks: Changes in source list composition over time can affect historical comparisons.
Bucketed or aggregated metrics may smooth out short-term fluctuations.
